shareholdingPatternNotes: The Company is filing the Shareholding Pattern under Regulation 31(1)(b) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, for the quarter ended 30th June, 2026, based on the Shareholding Pattern filed for the quarter ended 31st March, 2026. Since the due date for filing the Shareholding Pattern is today, i.e., 21st July, 2026, and in order to ensure compliance with the applicable regulatory timelines, the Company is filing the Shareholding Pattern based on the shareholding data for the previous quarter ended 31st March, 2026. Further, the Company shall separately submit the revised Shareholding Pattern along with copies of the email correspondence exchanged with the RTA and CDSL evidencing its follow-up for obtaining the BENPOS data.

name: Bhagyanagar India Limited
shareholdingPatternNotes: NOTE An auto-disseminated disclosure has appeared on the BSE / NSE portal under the System Driven Disclosure (SDD) mechanism maintained by CDSL, indicating an off-market sale of 12,73,335 equity shares of Bhagyanagar India Limited by Mr. Devendra Surana on December 29, 2025. In this regard, it is clarified that Mr. Devendra Surana is a Promoter and Managing Director of Bhagyanagar India Limited. The Company has a wholly owned subsidiary, Bhagyanagar Copper Private Limited, which is engaged in the manufacturing of copper products and, as a standard commercial practice, undertakes hedging of copper prices in the derivatives market to mitigate price volatility. For undertaking such hedging activity, margin security was required to be provided by way of pledge of shares held by the promoter. Due to certain technical constraints, the pledge could not be created directly from the demat account of Mr. Devendra Surana. Accordingly, to facilitate the pledge for business purposes, Mr. Devendra Surana transferred 12,73,335 equity shares of Bhagyanagar India Limited to the demat account of Bhagyanagar Copper Private Limited through an off-market transaction, clearly marked as transfer between director and company (Reason Code 90). No consideration was paid or received in connection with the said transfer. Subsequent to receipt of the shares, Bhagyanagar Copper Private Limited immediately created the requisite pledge and completed the hedge transaction. The movement of shares was a one-time technical transaction undertaken solely to safeguard the business interests of the Group. Accordingly, since no consideration was involved and the transfer was effected purely for pledge creation, the transaction does not constitute a sale or purchase of shares and should not be construed as such under the provisions of SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015, or SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

remarksWeb: The Promoter Agreement dated 23 February 2025 (as amended) executed by and amongst the Company, BSA Promoter Group (i.e. Dr. B.S. Ajaikumar, Ms. Bhagya A Ajaikumar, Ms. Anjali Ajaikumar Rossi, Ms. Aagnika Ajaikumar and Ms. Asmitha Ajaikumar), Hector Asia Holdings II Pte. Ltd. (Purchaser 1) and KIA EBT II Scheme 1 (Purchaser 2) (Purchaser 1 and Purchaser 2 collectively, Purchasers) (Promoter Agreement), which became effective from 30 May 2025, records inter-se rights and obligations of the Purchasers and the BSA Promoter Group. Under the terms of the Promoter Agreement, the BSA Promoter Group has undertaken that they shall not, directly or indirectly transfer or encumber equity securities in the Company other than pursuant to (i) a Permitted Sale that complies with Clause 6 (Transfer of Equity Securities) of the Agreement, including the right of first offer in favour of the Purchasers; or (ii) an encumbrance of equity securities up to 5% in aggregate of the share capital (or such additional equity securities as mutually agreed with the Purchaser in writing) by way of an Eligible Pledge; or (iii) a Permitted Sale of up to 3% of the share capital held by the BSA Promoter Group. These do not create any third party interest in these shares. As the definition of Encumbrance in the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 is broadly worded, the disclosure has been made on June 09, 2025 out of abundant caution. As no pledge or lien has been created on 30 May 2025, the number of encumbered shares continues to remain the same as the details set out in Promoter holding already pledged and reported under column XIV of the Shareholding pattern.
